source: projection of the sealed lot-4 harness cases of tests/profile_render/expected/ and tests/profile_export/expected/ (identical values)

comparators.note: canonical (RFC 8785) equality of the Result/1 or PureResult wire record after removing the UNSEALED pointers listed in the 'unsealed' artifact
each partial entry of the 'includes' artifact matches at least one actual report entry on its listed members (targetId compares source.targetId), checked before UNSEALED removal
prepareExport: the stage names observed through the pipeline observer seam equal the 'trace' artifact, in order, each once

LINK-ROUTE invariants for the records of the 'linkRoute' artifact: >= 2 waypoints, first inside or on the final source bounds, last inside or on the final target bounds, bounds = waypoint bounding box, endpoints unchanged
shared draw.io projection: one diagram per IR page {id, name, cells:[{id, kind, parent ($layer for the layer cell), value?, source?, target?}]} in document order, plus the byte invariants
canonical digest of every caller input identical before and after the call

notes: Paths in cases are relative to pathBase; package and load-input paths are repository-relative.
Every profile artifact is the composed profile of the harness case (vendored base plus its RFC 6902 patch); profileIdentity.sha256 = H(profile), independent of the file formatting.
Envelope artifacts are DocumentEnvelope/1 wire values; importedDi artifacts are Snapshot/1 importedDi records.
files covers every file under the parity directory except manifest.json itself.

Block-B parity sync: compileProfile records are PureResult records compared with result-exact/1 (PS-25, PS-35); export.prepare.success, export.prepare.repairable-pre-normalize and export.prepare.options-unknown-member are runtime-specific and not published (PS-36).

vendored lists the JS lot-4 cases the Python seal vendors (tests/profile_render/expected/vendor/js/, tests/profile_export/expected/vendor/js/); they are published by the JS corpus (bpmn-canvas:tests/fixtures/lot4-layout-export/expectations), sha256 = raw SHA-256 of the JS case file.
aliases lists the byte-identical twins (PS-37): the JS caseId has no Python record; aliasOf is the published Python case.
